value.rationale: Two separately labelled reset destination counts measure how a search allocates repeated relocation attempts. Their sign of dependence is a natural distinct observable from the total resets or mean completion time. The exact sharp geometric criterion, independence from all mixing weights, unique global transition, and nesting threshold graphs are nontrivial complete classifications for any finite collection of reset sites. Prior renewal identities give a route to derive such results but do not directly provide this classification.
